Phoolon ki kyari triangle jaisi hai, bhujayein 8 m, 9 m aur 14 m. Kinaare-kinaare ek baar baad lagani hai. Kitni baad bachegi, yeh jaanne se pehle kya nikaalna hoga?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain.

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao

Socho, tumhare paas 35 rupaye hain aur tum ek kitaab khareedte ho. Kitne bachenge, yeh kitaab ka daam jaane bina pata nahi chalta; maali ki baad mein bhi aisa hi kuch pehle jaanna hoga. Kyari ki bhujayein 8 m, 9 m aur 14 m hain, aur maali ke paas 35 m baad hai. Bachi baad ka hisaab kis naap se shuru hoga?

Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh kaam poora ho jaaye. Pehle is sawaal ka jawab do.

chauka

thak gayi, bye
